contentText:
The Playdate, Panic's tiny yellow handheld that launched in 2022 , has slowly but surely become a great deal - which is a good thing, because everything else in gaming has only gotten more expensive . Despite being a weird device with a black-and-white screen and a crank jutting out the side, the Playdate has managed to cultivate a strong and constantly growing library of games. And with the handheld's new season 3 of games , the deal has only gotten better.

Playdate's "seasons" are basically curated collections of games that are released over a short period of time. For season 3, there are eight games in total, with two launching weekly over …
